snapshot_status: artwork design reference; gameplay and technical docs define runtime behavior

content.scope: Production artwork and UI design delivery; Unity gameplay integration is a later task.
content.style: Warm hand-painted 2D side-view cartoon, crisp dark brown outlines, restrained cel shading, rounded friendly forms. Match reference screenshots.
content.light: Upper left, consistent soft highlights; no cast background shadows in transparent sprites.
content.characters: One elderly white-moustached miner design, yellow hardhat and brown boots/gloves. P1 orange clothes, P2 teal clothes. Same body proportions. Brown mole-like animal, small feet, rounded nose, no costume.

production.sprites: Genuine RGBA transparency, no labels, no checkered pattern baked into artwork, no dynamic text or numbers.
production.backgrounds: No miners, ropes, hooks, collectable ore, animals, UI or lettering baked into gameplay backgrounds.
production.text: Runtime Chinese text and values are separate from artwork.
production.animation: Separate moving parts or consistent pose strips; state sprites must not be described as rigged animations.
production.ui: Reuse panels and buttons, pressed/disabled states may be applied by code.
